items.wordHook: A handy item for 個(this) with suffix 子(child): 個子 means body height, build.
Combining 周(Zhou dynasty) and 圍(surround): 周圍 means neighborhood.
廚(kitchen) + 房(house) → the kitchen of a house: 廚房(kitchen).
所(that which) + 以(yǐ) → that which is the reason: 所以(therefore).
Extending a swift 扌(hand) with curling fingers clenched like sharp 爪(claws) allows you to snatch and 抓(catch).
Combining 比(compare) and 價(price): 比價 means compare prices.
Combining 現(appear) and 代(era): 現代 means modern times, the contemporary age.
a 糹(silk) thread rests along the 巠(underground river) → watching the current 經(pass through).
Combining 訊(news) and 息(end): 訊息 means information.
a 豸(badger) hides under 苗(sprouts) → 貓(cat).
Measuring the 距(distance) that lies 離(away from) two points: 距離 means distance.
a 門(door) opens a gap where the 日(sun) shines → its beam fills one room: 間(measure word for rooms).
A digital 電(electricity) circuit with particle 子(child) receiving 信(trust) mail in a 箱(box): 電子信箱 means email inbox.
A little 點(dot) to please the 心(heart) → 點心(a snack; light refreshments).
